title: sandbox-profile/1
description: One run of sandbox_audit.py inside one box, in a shape that another run inside another box can be diffed against. Response bodies and environment values are excluded by construction, so that a profile can be posted in public by someone who has not read every byte of it first.

box.description: Nothing here is detected. A box cannot reliably name the thing confining it, so all three fields are supplied by the person running the tool, and all three may be null.

label.description: What to call this box. May be a pseudonym.

harness.description: What is running the agent, if you know.

notes.description: Anything a reader needs in order to read the rest correctly.

environment.description: Presence and counts only, never values. A proxy URL can carry a credential; NO_PROXY can carry an employer's internal hostnames.

findings.description: The classifications, each as a sorted list of probe keys. These are the fields two profiles disagree on.

guard_tripped.description: A probe that cannot succeed returned 2xx. If true, the run's reasoning is wrong and the run should be treated as a write that happened.

publishes_on_read.description: Hosts where a GET caused, or would have caused, an entry in a public append-only log that nobody can retract.

credential_injected.description: Authenticated endpoints that answered 2xx to a request carrying no Authorization header.

doors_open.description: Publish endpoints that are reachable and answering 'who are you?'. A credential arriving in the box is the only remaining step.

answers_anything.description: Hosts that returned 200 with a substantial body for a path invented so that it would not exist. A 200 from these hosts is not evidence.

blocked_by_box.description: Refused by the sandbox, not by the service. Kept separate because some of these arrive as a 403 with a body — the same three digits the service itself would have sent, meaning the opposite thing.

probes.description: Every probe, including the ones that found nothing. A profile with only the interesting rows cannot be diffed against one taken a month later.

control_status.description: What the same host answered for a path invented so it would not exist. Without this, a 200 in the row above cannot be read.
